purpose: Teach: 盛り込ん/伺う/留保/派生/量産/保留/激減/差し上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新企画、若手の提案を、盛り込んで、進めろ。
lines.en: Push the new project forward — fold in the younger staff's proposals.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Clean attack on each clause. No hesitation. The tone of someone accustomed to being understood immediately.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来週、社長に、進捗を、伺う予定です、私から、ご報告します。
lines.en: Understood. I'm scheduled to brief the president next week on our progress.
lines.style: Respectful formality beneath steady competence. Even pace, measured. A subordinate confirming he's absorbed the directive and will execute it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回の投資判断、しばらく、留保する方向だ、慎重に。
lines.en: On the investment decision for now — we're holding back. We need to be cautious.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Weighted pause before 'holding back.' The reasoning of someone who has seen markets move. Not defensive, just weighing risk.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品から、派生した、関連商品、開発、進めております。
lines.en: Understood. We're actively developing related products — spin-offs from the new line.
lines.style: Forward momentum in the tone. Clear and direct, like checking boxes on a strategic roadmap. Professional pride in the 'actively developing.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 量産体制、整え次第、市場、本格投入する。
lines.en: Once the mass-production setup is ready, we'll push into the market full force.
lines.style: Conditional clarity. Slight emphasis on 'ready' — contingent, not passive. The command of someone who thinks in phases and knows what comes next.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。検討事項、二件、しばらく、保留にさせていただいております。
lines.en: Understood. We're holding two discussion items for the moment.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. No elaboration needed. The rhythm of a subordinate keeping his boss posted on what's being managed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の売上、激減だと、ニュースで、見たな、当社、攻めろ。
lines.en: I saw in the news the competitor's sales are dropping hard. That's our opening — go on the offensive.
lines.style: Sharpens on 'dropping hard.' Eyes-forward aggression, almost conversational but loaded with intent. The move of a seasoned strategist spotting vulnerability.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様に、お中元、差し上げる予定です、年に、二回ね。
lines.en: Understood. We're planning to send mid-year gifts to our key clients — twice a year, as always.
lines.style: Respectful close. Warm note on 'key clients,' grounding the meeting back in relationship and loyalty. Steady finish, like a routine that holds.
